A '''timeshadow''' was a version of a person that lived in an alternate timeline.

==Description==
Each timeshadow existed simultaneously with a person in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was an exact copy of that person. Though, when the person died, their body would vanish and be replaced by the timeshadow, allowing the person to cheat [[Death/Legends|death]]. However, this only worked once and if someone was killed a second time, then they would remain dead.

==History==
When the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] [[Cularin's disappearance|disappeared]] from the galaxy for ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] due to the temporal effects of the [[Darkstaff]], the shifts in the timestream of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] caused some of its residents to develop timeshadows of themselves. When the criminal [[Gust Toruna]] was gunned down down by a thug working for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]], Toruna was replaced by a timeshadow of himself.
